summary: A tense scene in a building where Dr. Kingsley abruptly tells Tresting and the narrator that she wants to call off an investigation and move back to Washington with her son. The narrator, holding a gun, presses her for an explanation, and she deflects, citing past death threats and madness. Agent Finch, visibly apprehensive, repeatedly asks whether she had any other visitors that day, and then asks her to recount her entire day, which suggests he suspects something is wrong.
one_line: Dr. Kingsley suddenly tries to end an investigation under gunpoint while Agent Finch probes her day for visitors.
key_facts: Dr. Kingsley tells the group, "I want to call off the investigation."
Kingsley says, "I'm taking my son and moving back to Washington."
Kingsley tells Finch that if "this is about Reginald, it's done."
Agent Finch goes white as a sheet after Kingsley's announcement.
The narrator waves a gun and declares, "Somebody better start explaining fast."
Kingsley reveals she had two police officers visit that day, who said they had another threat.
Tresting reminds Kingsley that after her first death threat she asked him what kind of shotgun to buy.
Tresting also told Kingsley to bug her phone and hoped the threateners would keep calling to give something away.
Kingsley says the investigation "has been like an addiction" and calls it "madness."
Kingsley twists her wedding ring while speaking to Tresting.
Finch asks, "Did you have any other visitors today?" and Kingsley says the only other visitor was Finch himself.
Finch asks Kingsley to "recount your entire day" for him.
The narrator notes that Finch seemed to have taken over completely while still being at a distance from the situation.
Tresting's eyes were pinched and he said nothing when Kingsley looked to him for help.

entities.name: Dr. Kingsley
entities.role: doctor at the center of the investigation who abruptly wants to call it off and move back to Washington with her son

entities.name: Tresting
entities.role: figure who steadies Kingsley and recalls her earlier requests about a shotgun and bugging her phone

entities.name: Agent Finch
entities.role: would-be FBI agent with a nasally voice who questions Kingsley about her visitors and day

entities.name: Reginald
entities.role: person whose name Kingsley links to the investigation
